subject: ela
cluster: Range of Reading and Level of Text Complexity
intro: Twelfth graders read and comprehend literature, including stories, dramas, and poems, at the high end of the grades 11-CCR complexity band, independently and proficiently, applying all skills: multiple themes, complex characters, figurative language, structure, point of view (including irony), and strong evidence.

items.prompt:
Read.

The reformer who spent his life fighting corruption took one bribe, just once, and never forgave himself.

What does this reveal, and what theme emerges?

steps: His single failure haunts a life of integrity.
So he is deeply principled, and the theme is that conscience holds us to our own standards.
solution.answer: He is deeply principled; theme: conscience holds us to our own high standards.

items.prompt:
Read.

The old house held its breath, waiting for footsteps that would never come.

Identify the device and its effect.

steps: The house is given human action (holding breath, waiting), so personification.
It conveys loneliness and a haunting absence.
So personification conveys a lonely, haunted emptiness.
solution.answer: Personification conveying a lonely, haunted emptiness.

items.prompt: To support an interpretation, cite the ____ evidence.

Trait?

Device?
